lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of large, high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. These form a semi-regular grid with three primary high-intensity spots aligned horizontally in the mid-flank region, flanked by smaller, less-defined clusters dorsally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, particularly noticeable in the transition zone between the fifth gill slit and the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a light-reflective upper surface to a dark-shadowed ventral margin, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregularities and minor notches are present along the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronate caustic light patterns from surface water refraction create high-contrast, non-biological vertical and wavy light-intensity lines across the entire dorsal and lateral surface.
